evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rising monotonically during growth: 8.9 → 10.1 → 18.2 → 24.3 ppm after having settled to ~5-8 ppm
Tube pressure creeping upward 2.998 → 3.072 → 3.135 → 3.212 Torr at constant Ar setpoint/flow
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so pressure rise is not from gas delivery

args.missing_evidence: Continued O2/P trend, and a leak-check discriminator (e.g., drop Ar flow or isolate tube and watch pressure/O2 response) to distinguish air ingress via a seal from exhaust restriction
